run_camera_control: run the locobot camera control example to set pan-tilt poses and capture RGB and depth images
create_robot_instance: create a pyrobot Robot instance for the locobot hardware platform
set_camera_pan_tilt: set the locobot camera pan and tilt angles using set_pan_tilt with wait enabled
capture_rgb_depth: capture RGB and depth images from the locobot camera using get_rgb and get_depth
reset_camera: reset the locobot camera to its default position using the camera reset method
